constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (cycle_id) REFERENCES scope_cycles(cycle_id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (exercice_id) REFERENCES scope_exercices(exercice_id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (lieu_id) REFERENCES scope_lieux(lieu_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (salle_theorie_id) REFERENCES scope_salles_theorie(salle_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (statcom_code) REFERENCES scope_statcom_referentiel(code) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (((business_code IS NULL) OR (stat_com_code IS NOT NULL)))
FOREIGN KEY (evenement_id) REFERENCES scope_evenements(evenement_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (publication_activity_id) REFERENCES scope_qv_publication_activities(publication_activity_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

indexes.indexdef: CREATE INDEX scope_evenements_analytics_idx ON public.scope_evenements USING btree (date, statut, mode_suivi, domaine_code)
CREATE INDEX scope_evenements_code_cours_search_idx ON public.scope_evenements USING btree (lower(code_cours) text_pattern_ops) WHERE (code_cours IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX scope_evenements_code_cours_uq ON public.scope_evenements USING btree (code_cours) WHERE (code_cours IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX scope_evenements_cycle_id_idx ON public.scope_evenements USING btree (cycle_id)
CREATE INDEX scope_evenements_date_statut_domaine ON public.scope_evenements USING btree (date, statut, domaine_code)
CREATE INDEX scope_evenements_equivalence_idx ON public.scope_evenements USING btree (domaine_code, exercise_equivalence_key)
CREATE INDEX scope_evenements_exercice_id_idx ON public.scope_evenements USING btree (exercice_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX scope_evenements_exercice_session_uq ON public.scope_evenements USING btree (exercice_id, session_index) WHERE ((exercice_id IS NOT NULL) AND (session_index IS NOT NULL))
CREATE INDEX scope_evenements_hidden_idx ON public.scope_evenements USING btree (hidden_at) WHERE (hidden_at IS NULL)
CREATE INDEX scope_evenements_identifiant_externe ON public.scope_evenements USING btree (identifiant_externe)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX scope_evenements_identifiant_externe_uq ON public.scope_evenements USING btree (identifiant_externe) WHERE (identifiant_externe IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX scope_evenements_internal_event_id_uq ON public.scope_evenements USING btree (internal_event_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX scope_evenements_pkey ON public.scope_evenements USING btree (evenement_id)
CREATE INDEX scope_evenements_pr_exercise_group_idx ON public.scope_evenements USING btree (cycle_id, pr_exercise_group_key) WHERE (pr_exercise_group_key IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX scope_evenements_publication_key_uq ON public.scope_evenements USING btree (publication_key) WHERE (publication_key IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX scope_evenements_qv_date_idx ON public.scope_evenements USING btree (date, date_fin, heure_debut, heure_fin) WHERE (publication_key IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX scope_evenements_standard_match_idx ON public.scope_evenements USING btree (date, domaine_code, sous_domaine_code, heure_debut, heure_fin)
CREATE INDEX scope_evenements_statcom_idx ON public.scope_evenements USING btree (statcom_code, date)
CREATE INDEX scope_evenements_temporal_idx ON public.scope_evenements USING btree (date, heure_debut_prevue, heure_debut_reelle)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX scope_event_code_allocations_evenement_id_key ON public.scope_event_code_allocations USING btree (evenement_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX scope_event_code_allocations_pkey ON public.scope_event_code_allocations USING btree (event_code)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX scope_event_code_allocations_rank_uq ON public.scope_event_code_allocations USING btree (statcom_code, sequence_number, suffix)
CREATE INDEX scope_event_code_allocations_statcom_sort_idx ON public.scope_event_code_allocations USING btree (statcom_code, sequence_number, suffix)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX scope_qv_publication_activities_code_uq ON public.scope_qv_publication_activities USING btree (source_year, business_code)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX scope_qv_publication_activities_identity_uq ON public.scope_qv_publication_activities USING btree (source_year, activity_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX scope_qv_publication_activities_pkey ON public.scope_qv_publication_activities USING btree (publication_activity_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX scope_qv_publication_links_evenement_id_key ON public.scope_qv_publication_links USING btree (evenement_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX scope_qv_publication_links_pkey ON public.scope_qv_publication_links USING btree (publication_link_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX scope_qv_publication_links_publication_key_key ON public.scope_qv_publication_links USING btree (publication_key)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX scope_qv_publication_links_source_uq ON public.scope_qv_publication_links USING btree (source_year, source_definition_id, source_occurrence_id, source_session_id, publication_unit_id)
